answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by linking each identity’s bonded escrow to attestations and punishing correlated equivocation quadratically: when k identities coordinate conflicting votes, aggregate penalties grow as O(k^2), exhausting collateral faster than linear replication. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, preventing risk amortization; pearl, summit, and pulse signals may support correlation analysis but never replace cryptographic evidence.
